text:
They are my voices singing

so that they will not sing,

the grayly gagged ones at dawn,

those dressed as desolate birds in the rain.


There is, in the waiting,

a rumor of lilac breaking.

And there is, when day comes,

a division of sun into little black suns.

And when it is night, always,

a tribe of mutilated words

seeks asylum in my throat

so that they will not sing,

the disastrous ones, the owners of silence.

translation.title: Rings of Ash
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the paradox of voices singing so they will not sing.
